goal: Expose an optional script evaluation tracer in libbitcoinkernel to inspect intermediate execution states
Allow external tooling like script debuggers and analyzers to observe step-by-step interpreter behavior
Help unit tests and fuzzing catch interpreter bugs before later error conditions shadow them
agreement: General concept approval for improving testing and developer tooling
Concept approval noting testing benefits without reviewing implementation (furszy)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, theStack)
Verified by building Python bindings and a visualizer with no issues found (elmeriniemela)

Useful auxiliary feature but reasonably deferrable
